desc:
🌱 Water the sand, grow the forest, restore the whole desert!

Start with a small watering can in an endless desert. Every drop brings life back: grass, trees and flowers grow as you water. Fill a whole region to unlock the next one, upgrade your gear and water faster and farther.

💧 Water and watch the desert turn green
⬆️ Upgrade your equipment
🗺️ Unlock new regions
🔍 Find the secrets hidden under the sand

Can you restore the entire desert?
